# Define Dataset class for images
class ImageDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, img_paths, target_paths=None, transform=None):
        self.img_paths = img_paths
        self.target_paths = target_paths
        self.transform = transform
        self.num_imgs = len(img_paths)

    def __len__(self):
        return self.num_imgs

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img = np.array(Image.open(self.img_paths[idx]))
        img = img.astype(np.float32) / 255.0

        if self.target_paths and idx < len(self.target_paths):
            target = np.array(Image.open(self.target_paths[idx]))
            target = target.astype(np.float32) / 255.0
            return torch.FloatTensor(img).unsqueeze(0), torch.FloatTensor(
                target
            ).unsqueeze(0)

        return torch.FloatTensor(img).unsqueeze(0)

        dataset.append({"img": img, "target": clean})
